high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Nikita Bier (@nikitabier) on Twitter. The tweet discusses the concept of a "Black Swan retention chart" within the social app industry, suggesting that such charts appear once per decade and that when they do, one should be involved in any capacity possible. The tweet includes a graph titled "D90 by friend count," which appears to be a retention chart showing the percentage of users retained over 90 days based on their number of friends.
